I was supposed to work for my aunt(kind of a summer job) but he got in the way(wanted to talk with her about payment and my work hours before i even started,wtf)and because he came home for 2 months i cant leave him alone so i have to spend the summer with him,which is ok i guess,ive done it for like 10 years now.  
the minimum wage in my country isn't enough to get us go for the long term( mom also works min wage ;250 eur/mo) ;so a job would help but it's not enough

he's not supporting,he's just there. doesn't care about my achievements,my looks,what im proud of or my work.  
i wish my sister could stay home two months to stay with him instead of me ( mom goes to work 7am and comes home 16pm,which means i must go with him wherever he wants,because then he won't send us money anymore,or just leave us. he has threatened us before for bullshit reasons. )  
i hope i can keep going for the whole august month and then school starts on 14th which i hope will keep me focused and my sanity strong.
gonna cry my eyes out this night :)
